title: Ten Red Hens
learning_objectives: Decode CVC words with short e
Keep reading short a, i and o words
parent_prompts: New sound: short e as in hen, pen, wet. Stretch it: h-e-n.
Count the hens on each page with the child after reading the words, not before.

pages.text: Ten red hens sit in a pen.
pages.illustration_brief: A wooden pen with a row of ten small red hens; Sam leaning on the fence.
pages.audio_script: Ten red hens sit in a pen.
pages.image_alt: A wooden pen with a row of small red hens; Sam leaning on the fence.

pages.text: Ben has a net. He gets one hen.
pages.illustration_brief: A boy with a small net gently lifting one hen; nine remain.
pages.audio_script: Ben has a net. He gets one hen.
pages.image_alt: A boy with a small net gently lifting one hen.

pages.text: The hen pecks Ben. Peck! Ben lets it go.
pages.illustration_brief: The hen pecking at Ben's sleeve; Ben pulling back.
pages.audio_script: The hen pecks Ben. Peck! Ben lets it go.
pages.image_alt: The hen pecking at Ben's sleeve; Ben pulling back.

pages.text: It is wet. The hens get wet. The pen is wet.
pages.illustration_brief: Rain over the pen; the hens huddled; wet ground.
pages.audio_script: It is wet. The hens get wet. The pen is wet.
pages.image_alt: Rain over the pen; the hens huddled; wet ground.

pages.text: Ben gets a big red bed of hay. The hens hop in.
pages.illustration_brief: A heap of hay under a little roof; hens hopping into it.
pages.audio_script: Ben gets a big red bed of hay. The hens hop in.
pages.image_alt: A heap of hay under a little roof; hens hopping into it.

pages.text: Ten red hens nap in the hay. Ben naps too. All are dry. All are glad.
pages.illustration_brief: Hens settled in hay; Ben sitting beside them under the roof.
pages.audio_script: Ten red hens nap in the hay. Ben naps too. All are dry. All are glad.
pages.image_alt: Hens settled in hay; Ben sitting beside them under the roof.

quiz.explanation: p-e-n. The middle sound is short e.

quiz.prompt: Why does Ben let the hen go?
quiz.explanation: Page 3 says: The hen pecks Ben. Peck, peck! Ben lets it go.

quiz.prompt: Why does Ben get the bed of hay?

options.text: So the wet hens can get dry

quiz.explanation: The hens got wet (page 4). After the hay, all are dry and glad (page 6).

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up what the hen did to Ben, and what Ben did for the hens at the end.
quiz.rubric: not yet: says hen only; with support: pecked, with prompting; independent: hen pecked Ben, rain made them wet, Ben gave them a hay bed
quiz.explanation: Two linked events show the child read across pages.

activities.prompt: Match the words with the same middle sound.

items.text: Ben gets one hen with a net.
The hens rest in the hay.

off_screen_prompt: Say five words with the e sound like hen. Clap for each one.

review.decodability_note: Short-e CVC: ten, red, hen(s), pen, Ben, net, get(s), let(s), wet, bed, rest(s) (rest = blend, kept), peck(s) (ck), yet; earlier patterns: sit, has, big, hop, in. 'hay', 'glad', 'dry', 'too' are on the irregular list or accepted as review words.
